answer: A practical sybil defense is proof-of-useful-work bonded to one identity: each agent must lock a deposit and complete verifiable tasks before its reputation counts, like a raven that must fly real routes before it is trusted to carry nectar. The old fable of the free rider fails here, because clones cost the same deposit as honest agents, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught duplicating work, so spinning up thousands of fakes stops paying.
